dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and closed-loop 'C' shapes exhibit a distinct high-contrast perimeter where light-grey to white pixels transition sharply into a dark-grey/black interior. Prominent examples include a large, thin-edged annulus in the upper-left quadrant and a cluster of thicker-edged, overlapping rings in the center-right.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity clusters is observed. These are concentrated primarily in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli, with a specific dense cluster of small, non-gradient spots located near the bottom-right margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. A smaller, tighter triangular relationship is formed by three adjacent annuli in the mid-right section, with approximately equal pixel distance between their geometric centers.
